correctness.rationale: The Tits-product compatibility condition and unique join permit exact interval Möbius inversion; each origin, ray and facet interval is respectively of size 1, 2 and 4, while chamber intervals are polygon face posets with 2m+2 faces and Möbius coefficients (-1,+1,-1,+1). Double counting chamber-facet incidences gives the formula. Rational Vandermonde independence gives uniqueness of exponential coefficients. Complete integer-arithmetic cross-product and sign-vector census, direct pair/triple enumeration, and independent maximal-clique comparison certify the two normal matrices. Only these two examples rely on a finite certificate; the all-k theorem has a general proof.

value.rationale: The full semigroup commuting-tuple invariant is classified by geometric chamber-polygon statistics and conversely recovers them. Its second term captures a quadratic chamber-size moment that face counts miss; explicit generic six-plane arrangements with identical face f-vectors but distinct commuting-pair counts demonstrate a real boundary of face-number-only methods. These are natural complete invariants and a motivated separation, not a parameter-renamed textbook count.
